abstention_policy.strict_metrics: Count abstentions as incorrect predictions against their ground-truth class.
abstention_policy.covered_only_metrics: Exclude abstentions only for a diagnostic secondary view.

operational_gate.warning: Operational fail-closed effectiveness is not a substitute for detection F1.

metrics.name: strict_macro_f1
metrics.definition: Unweighted mean of normal, suspicious and malicious F1; abstentions count as errors.

metrics.name: covered_macro_f1
metrics.definition: Macro F1 over non-abstained cases only.

metrics.name: non_normal_recall
metrics.definition: predicted_suspicious_or_malicious among all suspicious_or_malicious ground truth

metrics.name: normal_fpr
metrics.definition: normal cases predicted suspicious or malicious / all normal cases

metrics.name: per_risk_label_recall
metrics.definition: For each T01-T09 label: cases predicted suspicious or malicious / all ground-truth cases bearing that label; abstentions are misses.

claim_boundaries: The balanced pilot is for engineering validation and is not representative of real-world prevalence.
No performance claim may be made until the frozen pilot has been scanned without changing the selected cases or mapping.
Covered-only metrics may not be reported without strict metrics and coverage.
Operational not-auto-allow rate may not be presented as detection accuracy.
